A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CreRL research work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A-C are readable and support reliable comparison. V2 additionally includes a NeurIPS checklist.

before.justification: V1 reports original coverage-efficiency evaluations, out-of-distribution detection results, ablations, and ensemble-member accuracies in Section 5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical evaluations and reports revised CreBNN results in appendix Tables 6 and 8.

M1.justification: The relative-likelihood thresholds, early-stopped ensemble training, ToBias initialization, and interval-based credal predictions remain unchanged in Section 4 and Algorithm 1. Dropping the alpha subscript from some method-name mentions does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ChaosNLI, CIFAR-10 with CIFAR-10H annotations, and QualityMRI. The same OoD datasets remain: SVHN, Places365, CIFAR-100, Fashion-MNIST, and ImageNet. No task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: CreWra, CreEns, CreBNN, and CreNet participate in the same corresponding comparisons, with unchanged implementation descriptions. The newly cited Rashomon-set works are not evaluated as baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain the same models, training budgets, hyperparameters, label-sampling procedure, metrics, and OoD sampling and preprocessing. The revised CreBNN values are not accompanied by a reported protocol change.

E4.justification: The ToBias-constant and ensemble-size ablations, OoD alpha sweeps, and data-entropy analysis retain the same settings and findings. Appendix C.4 retains the same member-performance diagnostic; its numerical updates do not introduce or redesign an analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions disclose three runs or seeds and use the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting practice. Changes to CreBNN standard-deviation values are result revisions, not changes to uncertainty estimation. The checklist adds no statistical procedure.

E6.justification: Revisions are confined to CreBNN. Table 6 changes five entries, notably QualityMRI coverage from 0.780±0.312 to 0.898±0.133 and efficiency from 0.184±0.255 to 0.090±0.124. Table 8 revises all 20 ChaosNLI CreBNN member accuracies; member 1 changes from 0.512±0.083 to 0.680±0.013. Other numerical results and plotted findings remain unchanged. The PDFs do not explain whether these replacements reflect corrections or reruns.

T1.justification: The definitions of credal prediction, relative likelihood, alpha-cuts, coverage, efficiency, Pareto comparison, and entropy-based epistemic uncertainty are retained. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract and four stated contributions retain the same scope: relative-likelihood credal prediction, the coverage-efficiency formulation, ensemble approximation, and empirical comparison. The conclusion's revised wording about strong coverage does not establish a stronger scientific claim.

C2.justification: The explanations linking ToBias to diversity and alpha to coverage and OoD performance remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning neural-network-only evaluation, oversized interval-based sets, and unresolved approximation quality.

D1.justification: The new checklist explicitly states that run instructions are available in the already-linked repository, adding a limited reproducibility pointer. The repository URL, implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware specifications, runtime estimates, and dataset-access disclosures are otherwise unchanged; no new resource release is established.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds a paragraph connecting plausible-model collections to Rashomon sets, citing Semenova et al. (2022) and Donnelly et al. (2025). It distinguishes their interpretability and model-diversity objectives from this paper's uncertainty quantification and predictive diversity. Existing positioning is otherwise retained.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized prose corrections and terminology edits, updates author information and the conference footer, and adds acknowledgments and a standard NeurIPS checklist. The scientific narrative and organization of Sections 1-6 and Appendices A-C remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: V2 compacts the author block, adjusts figure placement and surrounding text flow, and changes caption emphasis and wording. All six figures and eight tables are retained; the figure graphics and table structures remain unchanged. The numerical table revisions are separate from these presentation edits.

improvement.justification: V2 resolves an internal inconsistency: Table 6's revised QualityMRI CreBNN coverage and efficiency now agree with the approximately (0.90, 0.09) point already shown in Figure 4. The added Rashomon-set discussion also improves research positioning. These are limited, supported gains; the other numerical replacements remain unexplained, and the method and experimental validation are otherwise unchanged.
